name: prockill
description: ProcKill — 跨平台进程管理器，支持 Tauri 桌面应用与 uTools 插件

scripts.check: bun run check:versions && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:utools
scripts.win: node scripts/guard-platform.mjs win32 && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.linux: node scripts/guard-platform.mjs linux && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.build:win: node scripts/guard-platform.mjs win32 && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/guard-platform.mjs linux && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.build:utools: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode utools && node scripts/build-utools.mjs
